title: SvgLine
responsibility: Renders the native line element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgLine.attributes
inputs.description: Native line attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgLine.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native line element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgLine
outputs.description: The actual native line element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
